blocks.text: The Global Insights dashboard provides a consolidated view of application sessions that are secured by ZSDK and allows you to understand where users are connecting from and how their digital experience performs.
A device is considered impacted when it participates in a Zscaler-secured application session during the selected time range.
On the Global Insights dashboard (Dashboards & Diagnostics > Global Insights):

blocks.item: Filters: Use filters to sort which devices to display.
Time range selection: Select a time range up to the previous three days to collect device data.
Global Session Heatmap: View the global map to understand where high network latency are based on the impacted devices. You can:
Heatmap slider: Adjust the colors for latency experience. Each color represents:
Green: Best latency experience.
Yellow: Average latency experience.
Red: Worst latency experience.
Hover over an impacted location to view granular details.
See image.
Overview: View the insightful and global overview of the digital experience for impacted devices, network latency, and ISP performance.
Total Sessions: The total number of Zscaler-secured application sessions across all devices in an organization.
Top Cities with Sessions: Up to the top 5 cities with the most sessions.
Top Locations with High Latency: Up to the top 5 locations with the highest latency.
Top ISPs with High Latency: Up to the top 5 ISPs with the highest latency.
Uplink Health by Region: View the comparison table between Wi-Fi and cellular health from impacted devices with the following information:
Region: The region where there are impacted devices.
Uplink Type: The type of internet access (e.g., Cellular, Wi-Fi).
Latency (P90 ms): The 90th percentile network latency of the devices.
Top ISP: The ISP name that has the most impacted devices.
Health: The health of the internet access.
Good: The network latency is below or equal to 200 ms.
Okay: The network latency is within the range of 201 ms to 600 ms.
Bad: The network latency is above 600 ms.
Android/iOS: The percentage of device OS distribution.
You can modify the columns as needed and navigate through pages.
ISP Leaderboard: View the most impacted ISPs with the following information:
ISP: The impacted ISP's name.
Regions: The number of impacted regions.
Latency (P90 ms): The 90th percentile network latency of the devices.

Session Share: The percentage of application sessions that are sending traffic through the ISP. For example, if 3 out of 10 total application sessions in your organization are sending traffic through the ISP, then 30% of the total application sessions share the ISP.
Health: The health of the internet access.
Good: The network latency is below or equal to 200 ms.
Okay: The network latency is within the range of 201 ms to 600 ms.
Bad: The network latency is above 600 ms.
You can modify the columns as needed and navigate through pages.
Network Path: View Sankey visualizations to observe the network paths between Zscaler and App Connectors.
Hover over a network path to view specific segment details.
